relationship_to_original_review: contracts/learning-validation-95-contradiction-summary.candidate.v1.json records p1=4 and 15 total CR-LV-001..015 ids, but the original cross-capability review's own P1-severity content (which of the 15 ids are P1, and what each names) was never materialized anywhere in the repository -- only the aggregate count survived. The classes below are Claude's own derivation from the FR-LEARN-001~095 corpus, textually grounded and disjoint from 158's 11 P0 classes, NOT a claim to have recovered the original review's exact 4. They use new CR-LV-P1-* ids specifically so they are never confused with a recovered CR-LV-001..015 mapping.

classes.title: Federated Aggregation Mechanism vs Tenant Isolation
classes.precedence: Minimum cohort size / outlier-dominant aggregation fails closed to REJECTED. Every aggregation round requires explicit per-tenant opt-in, not substituted by asset-promotion consent. Re-identifying diagnostics stay evaluator-only.

classes.title: Reviewer/Evaluator Diversity Requirement vs Qualified-Reviewer Scarcity
classes.precedence: A pool too small to satisfy diversity is never silently treated as satisfying it. Decisions get a REDUCED_INDEPENDENCE_DISCLOSED flag with real overlap reasons; high-risk (FR-LEARN-093 scope) decisions HOLD until additional external reviewers are secured.

classes.title: Decision Explanation Fidelity vs Sealed Challenge/Benchmark Secrecy
classes.precedence: Explanations faithfully cite the real evidence/rule/oracle/policy identifiers and rationale used, but never reproduce sealed fixture content verbatim -- references are redacted/abstracted digests; audits needing the original go through an evaluator-only channel.

classes.title: Emergency Global Revocation Speed vs Data Residency/Air-gapped Isolation
classes.precedence: Legal basis for emergency cross-border revocation transfer into sovereignty-restricted regions is secured in advance (authority_refs bound before an incident, not during one). Air-gapped environments never claim real-time currentness -- they carry an explicit PROPAGATION_LAG_DISCLOSED SLA (STALE until next sync window) instead.
